items.title: Dave Bailey and John McNeil Interview, 1959-10-25
items.q: The interviewee mentions 'Jimmy' and 'Jim' in the context of a baseball league ('we was in the league up there') and a drumming challenge, but does not explicitly state a musical collaboration or close personal relationship with this specific 'Jim' in the provided text, distinguishing him from the n

ctx.x: They called him Gooey. He lived up in town somewhere. So Jimmy was playing with him, you know. And we was in the league up there. But at least I had to stop playing. So Jim was playing with him, you know. And we was in the league, I believe. But at least I had stopped playing. And I got to lose all the drums, they gave me the drum solo. The people around me like that. Little Jim wasn't stood up to call him. He said he got to give it to him, he said he's the best, there ain't nothing to do like that man. That Jim…
